name: Agentcast
description: A library of reusable sub-agent personas, validated and scored.

skills.name: persona-validate
skills.description: Validate and score persona files before they ship, or as a pre-merge check on any .claude/agents/ folder.

skills.name: persona-scaffold
skills.description: Write a new persona for a role the library lacks, one that validates and scores at least 7.

skills.name: persona-cast
skills.description: Pick, trial, install and prove the right persona for a job, including one someone else wrote.
